function: Learned design of the ISAC dual-functional transmit waveform and receive filter, minimizing multi-user interference plus reciprocal sensing SINR under constant-modulus and similarity constraints (p. 5)
system: Half-duplex ISAC base station with Nt=6 transmit and Nr receive antennas serving K=2 single-antenna users, J=2 clutter points; no RIS; no RF band stated (p. 4, p. 10)
method: Deep unfolding of an ADMM algorithm into ADMM-DL-NET (Uzawa) and ADMM-PGD-NET (projected gradient) with learnable step sizes and penalties; unsupervised training, objective as loss (p. 8-9)
data_channel: Custom simulation: Gaussian communication channels, pathloss 5e-3, line-of-sight target and clutter steering vectors; 100 training samples; no standard model or measurement (p. 4, p. 10-11)
test_conditions: NNs trained in Channel 1; tested in Channels 2 and 3 (different realizations) and over SNR, slots L, gamma sweeps; 1000 Monte Carlo runs (p. 10, 12-13)
baselines: Non-learned: ADMM, ADMM-PGD, ADMM-DL iterative algorithms. Learned: USL, an unsupervised feed-forward network with Q hidden layers of 500 neurons (p. 11-12)
metrics: Achievable rate, sensing SNR, beampattern, training-loss convergence, CPU training and testing time, number of learnable parameters (p. 11-13)
complexity: O(Q(M+1)Nt^3 L^3) for both networks; 2(Q-1)+QM learnable parameters (p. 10); CPU training and testing times in Table IV (p. 13)
q1_support: p. 10: "All communication channels follow the Gaussian distribution" with pathloss 5e-3; target and clutter links are line-of-sight steering vectors (p. 4). Missing: any 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO model or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "Although the NNs are trained in Channel 1, they can perform well in both Channel 2 and Channel 3"; Fig. 12 (p. 12) calls them "different channel realizations". Missing: any new scenario, antenna or user number, or distribution.
q3_support: p. 11: "USL: The feed-forward neural network (FNN) with Q hidden layers and 500 neurons per hidden layer"; p. 13: "The proposed two deep unfolding NNs are superior to the USL" in achievable rate, and comparable to non-learned ADMM (Fig. 10).
q4_support: p. 10: "The approximate computational complexity of both ADMM-DL-NET and ADMM-PGD-NET" is O(Q(M+1)Nt^3 L^3), with 2(Q-1)+QM learnable parameters; p. 13: Table IV gives CPU training and testing times.
q5_support: p. 10: "All communication channels follow the Gaussian distribution"; the data are self-simulated. Missing: any code or data link, or public dataset; the paper has no availability statement.
notes: ISAC area 5: the learned element is the unfolded transmit waveform and receive filter design. q2 borderline: Fig. 12 (p. 12-13) trains on Channel 1 and tests on Channels 2 and 3, but the paper defines them only as different realizations of the same Gaussian model, read here as held-out data, so q2=0 for reviewer confirmation. q3: USL is a generic fully connected network (standard architecture on the same problem) and ADMM is the non-learned optimization algorithm. Table I, Table III, Table IV and Fig. 12 were read as page images (p. 3, 11-13).
